title: flex-sankey: a modular library for Sankey diagram layout with overlap-free flow geometry
description:
A modular Sankey diagram layout library for JavaScript. The layout is exposed as six separable stages rather than a single entry point: link crossings are reduced by a median or barycentre sweep refined with simulated-annealing swaps; node coordinates are settled by a one-dimensional spring relaxation with separate stiffnesses for edge, node and margin springs; and links are drawn with a ribbon geometry built from paired cubic Béziers that prevents parallel links from overlapping. Three clutter-reducing encodings extend the layout itself rather than the renderer: packed paths, totalizing nodes and hidden nodes.

This archive contains the complete library, its test suite, nine interactive demos, and the full reproduction material for the accompanying paper: the benchmark dataset manifest, the generated datasets, the measurement code, the comparison harness and the scripts that produce every figure and table.
